content: - \(\mathcal{M}^t = (\mathcal{K}_{\mathrm{req}}^t, \{b\} \cup \mathcal{U})\) consists of the tasks of MDs and the MEC servers.

- \(\mathcal{L}^t = (\mathcal{L}_{\mathcal{K}_i^\mathbf{t}}^t, \mathcal{L}_j^t)\) consists of the preference lists of the tasks and MEC servers. Each task \(\mathcal{K}_i^\mathbf{t} \in \mathcal{K}_{\mathrm{req}}^t\) has a descending ordered preferences over the MEC servers, i.e., \(\mathcal{L}_{\mathcal{K}_i^\mathbf{t}}^t = \{j | j \in \{b\} \cup \mathcal{U}, j \succ_{\mathcal{K}_i^\mathbf{t}} j'\}\), where \(\succ_{\mathcal{K}_i^\mathbf{t}}\) is the preference of task \(\mathcal{K}_i\) towards the servers. Moreover, each MEC server \(j\) has a descending ordered preference list over the tasks, i.e., \(\mathcal{L}_j^t = \{\mathcal{K}_i^\mathbf{t} \in \mathcal{K}_{\mathrm{req}}^t, \mathcal{K}_i^\mathbf{t} \succ_j \mathcal{K}_i^{\mathbf{t}'}\}\).

- \(\Pi^t \subseteq \mathcal{K}_{\mathrm{req}}^t \times \{b\} \cup \mathcal{U}\) denotes the matching between the tasks and MEC servers. Each task \(\mathcal{K}_i^{\mathbf{t}} \in \mathcal{K}_{\mathrm{req}}^t\) can be matched with at most one MEC server, i.e., \(\Pi_{\mathcal{K}_i^{\mathbf{t}}}^t \in \{b\} \cup \mathcal{U}\), while each MEC server \(j\) can be matched with multiple tasks, i.e., \(\Pi_j^t \subseteq \mathcal{K}_{\mathrm{req}}^t\).

content: 1) Scenarios: We consider a UAV-assisted MEC system where one MBS and four UAVs are deployed to jointly provide offloading service for 30 MDs in a  \( 1000 \times 1000 \, m^{2} \)  rectangular area. The time horizon is set as 60s, and it is divided into T = 600 time slots with equal length of  \( \delta = 100 \, ms \) , and 10 time slots are grouped into a time epoch, i.e.,  \( \Delta = 1 \, s \) .

2) Parameters: For the MBS, the location and height are set as [500, 500] and \(10\mathrm{m}\) [41], respectively. For UAVs, the fixed altitude is set as \(H = 100\mathrm{m}\), and the initial positions and destinations are set as \((\mathbf{q}_1^I,\mathbf{q}_1^F) = ([50,900],[500,500]),(\mathbf{q}_2^I,\mathbf{q}_2^F) = ([900,900],[500,500]),(\mathbf{q}_3^I,\mathbf{q}_3^F) = ([100,100],[500,500]),(\mathbf{q}_4^I,\mathbf{q}_4^F) = ([800,1000],[500,500])\) , respectively. The default values of the other parameters are listed in Table II.
3) Benchmarks: This work evaluates the proposed TJCCT in comparison with the following schemes.
- Local-only strategy (LS): All MDs process the tasks locally without considering the MEC server resource allocation and UAV trajectory control.
